name: bums.showdown.w3-b.name
authorNotes: Showdown / survive, 2-4 players, enclosed single-screen arena (no split-screen camera needed, §5). All four spawn together on the base ring; the 'big-top-drop' hazard is a crusher shaped as the canvas winch pulling the whole tent floor upward, its path climbing from y1300 (below the ring) to y150 (above the top perch) at 15.3px/s — the same rising-wall approximation w1-b flagged for its own tide, and the same schema gap: the Hazard contract has no time-varying shape/size field, only a static Shape plus a kinematic path, so 'the tent is coming down' is authored as one large hazard translating upward rather than a true shrinking floor. A ~75s rise from ring to summit matches §8.2's 'closing lethal boundary forces an end within 75s'. Players retreat upward via trapeze-survive-mid then trapeze-survive-top as the floor climbs; the top perch is the last refuge and holds only one comfortably, which is the point. relic-w3-b sits on the top perch as a risk/reward pickup for the haul objective. A static void strip under the base ring punishes anyone knocked clean off before the winch even reaches them.
